value.markup:
Each template is a site to start from: its types, views, styles and starting content. init --template scaffolds one into an empty folder.

| Template | What it is |

| --- | --- |

| Basic | a Content Page type with a title, an image and a description, its template, and a published welcome page; what a plain init gives you |

| Next.js | an empty site with a Next.js front end in web/, wired for preview, revalidation and member sign-in |

| Crombolo | a full site about Crombolo, in English and Spanish: a home page built from blocks, features filtered by category, people from the Library, a blog with tags and paging, search, and a contact form |

| Harbourstone Distillery | a coastal distillery: a range with tasting-note elements, reusable highlights, a contact form, photographs and a stylesheet |

| Harbourstone Distillery (Next.js) | the Harbourstone distillery with a Next.js front end in web/: the same content, drafts in Draft Mode, a cache cleared by webhook, and a comparison of the bottlings chosen in the browser |

| Plain Signal | an AI magazine for everyone: sections, articles with photographs and their credits, a sub-editor and editor approval workflow, and a contact form drawn by an island |

| Starter | a header, a footer and a two-column page layout with placeholder text, ready to restyle |

To list them from the command line:

bunx @crombolo/cli@latest init --template list
